Interface TurSearchEnginePlugin

All Known Implementing Classes:
TurElasticsearchSearchEnginePlugin, TurLuceneSearchEnginePlugin, TurSolrSearchEnginePlugin
public interface TurSearchEnginePlugin
Interface for search engine plugins that can be used by Turing. Implementations include Solr, Elasticsearch, and Lucene.

Each plugin owns all index lifecycle, schema, document, and monitoring operations for its engine. Callers should resolve the plugin via TurSearchEnginePluginFactory and call the appropriate method without needing to know which engine is in use.

Since:
2025.4.4
Author:
Alexandre Oliveira

    • createIndex

      void createIndex(TurSEInstance seInstance, TurSNSiteLocale siteLocale, String indexName, Map<String, TurSEFieldType> fieldTypes)
      Creates an index/core for the given SE instance. Solr uses the locale language to pick the configSet; Lucene/ES ignore siteLocale.

    • createStandaloneIndex

      default void createStandaloneIndex(TurSEInstance seInstance, Locale language, String indexName)
      Creates a standalone index/core without requiring a site locale entity. Uses only the language to determine the configSet (Solr) or creates the index directly (Lucene/ES).
      Parameters:
      seInstance - the search engine instance
      language - the locale language (e.g., Locale.forLanguageTag("en"))
      indexName - the name for the new index/core
